Container.Name: Homewarden
Container.Overview: Keeps track of every device in your homelab: which ones are on, which software versions they run and what needs updating. Updates run per component or all at once, manually or on a schedule. Set up entirely in the web interface. Meant for the local network only: put it behind your reverse proxy, never expose it to the internet. On first start, open the web interface and enter the setup token printed in the container log to create the admin account.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Database, encrypted credentials, installed integrations and the master key. Back up this folder to back up Homewarden. The container fixes the ownership to PUID:PGID on start.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Lets Homewarden see and update the containers on this Unraid server. Remove this row if you do not want that. Read-write is needed to update containers; read-only is enough to only see them.

Config.Name: Backups folder (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. A folder for device backups (for example OctoPrint backups). Add it under Backups as a folder target with the path /backups. An SMB share works as well and needs no mapping.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id Homewarden runs as. 99 is Unraid's nobody. Set 0 to run as root (not needed for anything).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id Homewarden runs as. 100 is Unraid's users.
